text:
Rhea (Product): Heads-up: Sales intake from SaasCo — they want Aureus-14B-quant-v2 pinned in eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-2, plus a guaranteed fallback to Aureus-8B-quant. Requirements from the email: p95 < 250ms for 512-token chat, monthly throughput ~1.2M tokens, and data isolation for PII. Go-live target they mentioned: 2025-08-01. Copy of customer note below.

Tom (Sales): Copy. They also said embeddings workload will be heavy; they want quantized FP16/4-bit supported and a staged roll-out.

Priya (Customer Success): CS can run compliance questionnaire. They flagged VPC as preferred — will push NDA.

Ishan (Eng-ML): Aureus-14B-quant-v2 is not in our catalog yet. We need model artifact (weights + config) and a perf profile. Do we have sample prompts from the customer?

Rhea (Product): Yes — short-chat, long-context summarization, and embed generation. Emphasis on chat latency. I pasted the sample prompt set from their email into the intake ticket.

Olivia (Eng-Infra): @Ishan quick ask: what's the expected GPU footprint if they use q4_0 or q8_0 quant? Can we bucket this into a Dedicated pool?

Ishan (Eng-ML): Estimate: Aureus-14B quant (4-bit) ~ ~28GB model RAM + KV working set. On A100-80 it will run, but to hit their throughput we'd want 3 replicas per region with continuous batching. Fallback (Aureus-8B-quant) needs separate verification.

Ishan (Eng-ML): ```
model: aureus-14b-quant-v2
replicas: 3
gpu: a100-80
quant: q4_0
padding: dynamic
routes:
  - chat: /v1/chat
  - embed: /v1/embeddings
slo:
  p95_latency_ms: 250
```

Olivia (Eng-Infra): Noted. For EU + APAC we should plan dedicated pools: 3 nodes EU + 3 nodes APAC + warm standby. Also need warmup image and autoscale policy.

Rhea (Product): Proposed triage: M1 (collect artifacts + vendor perf data) due in 5 business days; M2 (catalog entry + basic pin in hosted) after artifacts; M3 (Dedicated pool + SLO verification + routing) as separate epic. Sales urgency is high but no enterprise contract yet.

Tom (Sales): Customer is ok with staged rollout. They said if we can commit to throughput and a migration path to Dedicated, they'll start in hosted. I'll request artifacts and ask about sample load.

Priya (Customer Success): Sending NDA and compliance checklist to customer now.

deploy-bot: deploys: No active deploys for aureus models.

Ishan (Eng-ML): Question: do we already have Aureus-8B-quant in the catalog as a verified fallback? If not, add compatibility matrix to tasks.

Rhea (Product): Good call. Added task: verify Aureus-8B behavior and create mapping in smart routing for geo fallback + cost tiering.

Olivia (Eng-Infra): Action: infra to estimate cost delta and capacity plan for quant vs non-quant across both regions. I'll ping infra-costs channel.

Rhea (Product): I'll open a Jira intake ticket and link it here with triage score 6/10. Proposed owners: Ishan (perf & model verification), Olivia (infra sizing), Priya (customer comms), Tom (sales follow-up). Any objections?

Tom (Sales): :thumbsup: go for it. I'll push for the artifacts timeline.

Priya (Customer Success): LGTM.

Ishan (Eng-ML): I'll begin perf benching as soon as artifacts arrive.

Rhea (Product): OK — next steps: Tom to get artifacts + sample load; Priya to handle NDA; Ishan to prepare bench harness; Olivia to draft capacity plan. I'll update Jira and circle back.

Tom (Sales): On it. ETA for artifacts: 48-72 hours from customer.

Rhea (Product): Great. Thanks everyone.
